classification.difficultyReason: Select the similar pair from three candidates, distinguish applicable tests and preserve matching vertex order.

content.prompt: Name the pair of similar triangles in each part, naming the vertices in matching order and stating the similarity test.

spec.description: Three separate upward-pointing triangles in a horizontal comparison row; ordinary source blue outlines are reconstructed in house black.
spec.mathematics: ABC: A=40 degrees, C=55 degrees. DEF: D=30 degrees, E=100 degrees. GHI: H=85 degrees, I=55 degrees. All vertex labels retained.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens; no calculated angles or selected pair.

answer.worked:
$\angle ABC=180^\circ-40^\circ-55^\circ=85^\circ$.

Thus $\angle ABC=\angle GHI=85^\circ$ and $\angle ACB=\angle GIH=55^\circ$.

Therefore $\triangle ABC\sim\triangle GHI$ (AAA).

spec.description: Three separate right triangles in one horizontal row, with vertical left legs and horizontal lower legs.
spec.mathematics: KM=9 cm, ML=12 cm, angle M=90 degrees; NQ=6 cm, QP=7 cm, angle Q=90 degrees; RT=3 cm, TS=4 cm, angle T=90 degrees.

answer.worked:
$$\frac{KM}{RT}=\frac{9}{3}=3,\qquad\frac{ML}{TS}=\frac{12}{4}=3.$$

The included angles satisfy $\angle KML=\angle RTS=90^\circ$.

Therefore $\triangle KML\sim\triangle RTS$ (SAS).

spec.description: Three downward-pointing triangles in a horizontal comparison row; retain redundant side lengths.
spec.mathematics: KLM: K=25 degrees, M=100 degrees, KM=4 cm, LM=3 cm. NPQ: N=25 degrees, P=55 degrees. RST: S=60 degrees, T=100 degrees, RT=4 cm.

answer.worked:
$\angle KLM=180^\circ-25^\circ-100^\circ=55^\circ$.

Thus $\angle LKM=\angle PNQ=25^\circ$ and $\angle KLM=\angle NPQ=55^\circ$.

Therefore $\triangle KLM\sim\triangle NPQ$ (AAA).

spec.description: Three differently oriented triangles in one horizontal comparison row; the middle 70-degree angle is at Q, not between its two labelled sides.
spec.mathematics: KL=8 cm, KM=6 cm, K=70 degrees; PR=16 cm, PQ=12 cm, Q=70 degrees; ST=18 cm, SU=24 cm, S=70 degrees.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens; no angle arcs added where the source has labels alone.

answer.worked:
$$\frac{LK}{US}=\frac{8}{24}=\frac13,\qquad\frac{KM}{ST}=\frac{6}{18}=\frac13.$$

The included angles satisfy $\angle LKM=\angle UST=70^\circ$.

Therefore $\triangle LKM\sim\triangle UST$ (SAS).

spec.description: Three separate triangles arranged horizontally, preserving distinct orientations and all side lengths.
spec.mathematics: XYZ: XY=4 cm, YZ=8 cm, XZ=10 cm. DEF: DE=14 cm, DF=12 cm, EF=6 cm. KLM: KM=9 cm, KL=18 cm, ML=21 cm.

answer.worked:
$$\frac{DE}{LM}=\frac{14}{21}=\frac23,\qquad\frac{EF}{MK}=\frac69=\frac23,\qquad\frac{FD}{KL}=\frac{12}{18}=\frac23.$$

All three pairs of matching sides have the same ratio, so $\triangle DEF\sim\triangle LMK$ (SSS).
